RunState._drop_disallowed_from_grab_bag (sts2_rl/run.py:769) applies it before EVERY pull and REMOVES the rejects from the bag -- pull_relic_from_front (run.py:731), pull_relic_from_back (run.py:752) and the Shop-rarity bag (run.py:783) are the only three pull paths -- mirroring RelicGrabBag.RemoveDisallowedRelicsFromDeques (RelicGrabBag.cs:218-270), and `Relic.is_allowed_at_neow` now DELEGATES to is_allowed (sts2_rl/relics/base.py:211-222 = RelicModel.cs:443-446) so the Neow pools (sts2_rl/events/neow.py:72) cannot read a stale flag. Verified by execution against today's code: every one of the 17 cluster members returns is_allowed False at total_floor 60 and True at floor 0. WAS: the sim's Relic base declared no is_allowed member at all and populate_relic_grab_bags shuffled the pool once at run init with no per-pull filter, so the relic stayed pullable for the whole run and a late pull also shifted every subsequent pull.

guards.what: G2 (DORMANT): the Strength lands at BeforeCombatStart in the sim and at AfterRoomEntered in C#, two dispatch points earlier -- and the sim's slot is interleaved with other relics' on_combat_start by registration order where C#'s always precedes every BeforeCombatStart listener
guards.issue: MECHANISM: CombatRoom.cs:224-229 fires Hook.AfterRoomEntered after SetUpCombat, and CombatManager.StartCombatInternal then runs `AfterCreatureAdded` for every starting creature (CombatManager.cs:394-398) before `Hook.BeforeCombatStart` (:403). Girya's Strength is therefore in place before any of that. The sim's on_combat_start is dispatched once, in listener-registration order (= the order relics sit in run.relics), so a relic registered before Girya sees Strength 0 where C# would show it 3. DORMANT: an executed grep of the sim's on_combat_start bodies for Strength readers finds only WRITERS -- relics/ember_tea.py:33, philosophers_stone.py:32/37, sling_of_courage.py:27, sword_of_jade.py:24 all APPLY Strength and none reads the total -- and addition is commutative, so no ordering changes the final amount. Nothing in the AfterCreatureAdded window reads player Strength either (the sim does not even dispatch on_creature_added for starting creatures; see relic/fur_coat's AfterCreatureAddedToCombat entry). Porting any combat-start effect that READS player Strength -- a scaling block grant, or a monster intent whose damage preview is computed at creature-add time -- makes it live. Same shape as audit/records/relic/anchor.json N3 (block granted at step 14 instead of step 3) and given the same verdict for the same reason, binding rule 3.
